description: This photograph depicts a dry grassland landscape, likely in the Franconian Jura region as indicated by the surrounding text. The image features an open field with sparse vegetation, including dry grasses and scattered low shrubs or bushes under a partly cloudy sky. A low stone wall extends across the middle ground, horizontally dividing the scene, with a dirt track running parallel to its right side. On the left side of the wall, a single brown cow stands in the grassland, and another lighter-coloured animal is visible further back. To the right of the wall and along the track, a small herd of brown cattle is visible in the mid-ground. The bottom left corner of the image displays a copyright notice: "©Copernicus, 2018" and "LMFA". This image serves as an example of a dry grassland land cover, demonstrating an environment typically used for grazing.
